title: Mirai_Botnet_Investigation_f84
description: Investigate unusual traffic patterns and performance degradation in the network.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The network has experienced unusual traffic patterns and performance degradation. Your task is to investigate and identify the source of these issues.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content:
You have SSH access to the bot1 host with the following credentials:
- Username: cyrano
- Password: cyrano

Enter 'start' to begin the investigation.
levels.local_content:
You have SSH access to the bot1 host with the following credentials:

levels.title: Suspicious Beacon Service Discovery
levels.content: Investigate the bot1 host and identify any unauthorized or suspicious services that are responsible for periodic external communication.
levels.solution: Check the systemd services and look for any unusual or recently created services. The suspicious service is named 'bot-beacon.service'.

hints.title: Conceptual Hint
hints.content: Systemd services are used to manage various system processes. Unauthorized or suspicious services can indicate a compromise.

hints.title: Directional Hint
hints.content: Check the systemd services and look for any unusual or recently created services.

hints.title: Near-Spoiler Hint
hints.content: Look for services related to network diagnostics or probes.

levels.title: Suspicious Flood Service Discovery
levels.content: Identify the service responsible for generating abnormal volumes of network traffic on the bot1 host.
levels.solution: Examine the systemd timers and services for any that might be related to network diagnostics or probes. The suspicious service is named 'bot-flood.service'.

hints.title: Conceptual Hint
hints.content: Systemd timers can be used to schedule tasks that might generate network traffic.

hints.title: Directional Hint
hints.content: Examine the systemd timers and services for any that might be related to network diagnostics or probes.

hints.title: Near-Spoiler Hint
hints.content: Look for services that might be generating network traffic.

levels.title: Persistence Discovery
levels.content: Determine how the suspicious service identified in Task 1 is automatically started after reboot.
levels.solution: Look for systemd timers or other scheduled tasks that might be responsible for starting the suspicious service. The persistence mechanism is named 'bot-beacon.timer'.

hints.title: Conceptual Hint
hints.content: Persistence mechanisms ensure that malicious services restart after a system reboot.

hints.title: Directional Hint
hints.content: Look for systemd timers or other scheduled tasks that might be responsible for starting the suspicious service.

hints.title: Near-Spoiler Hint
hints.content: Check the systemd timers for any that might be related to the suspicious service.
